articles.title: Jacques Lacan, psychoanalyst: “To love is to give what one does not have to someone who is not it”
articles.standfirst: This is Lacan's reflection on love.
articles.summary: This is Lacan's reflection on love.
articles.body:
Love is one of the most complex themes of the human experience and has been analyzed from different perspectives, such as philosophy, literature, and psychology. For the French psychoanalyst J acques Lacan , loving does not simply consist of giving something material or satisfying another person's needs, but rather implies recognizing our own shortcomings and accepting that the other is also an incomplete being, with desires and needs that we cannot fully control.

The phrase “To love is to give what one does not have to someone who is not it” is one of Lacan’s best-known formulations. Its meaning may seem contradictory at first glance, but it offers a profound reflection on desire, lack, and the expectations we build around romantic relationships.

Next, on MARCA MX we will tell you more about this reflection by Lacan on love.

What does this phrase by Jacques Lacan mean?

The phrase by Jacques Lacan means that love is not based solely on offering something we possess, but also on sharing our vulnerability, our feelings, and that which we recognize as a lack within ourselves. From the psychoanalyst's perspective, loving implies relating to another person without having the ability to complete them or to turn them into the ideal we imagine.

To understand this idea, it is necessary to analyze its two parts. The first, “giving what one does not have” , can be interpreted as the ability to offer something that is neither a material object nor a possession. A person can give love, trust, attention, or commitment without these feelings being things they can store or hand over as if they were goods. Love implies exposing oneself emotionally , recognizing one’s own limitations, and accepting that we do not always have all the answers.

In this sense, loving does not mean presenting oneself to someone as a perfect person, capable of solving any problem or satisfying all their needs. It also involves recognizing one’s own insecurities, accepting mistakes, and building a bond based on honesty. What is offered is not a nonexistent perfection, but rather a relationship in which both people can show themselves as they are.

The second part of the phrase, “to someone who is not” , often turns out to be even more enigmatic. Within Lacan's thought , it can be understood as a reference to the fact that the other never fully coincides with the ideal image we construct of them.

Sometimes, a person falls in love not only with the person in front of them, but also with what they imagine that person represents: security, happiness, recognition, or the promise of filling an emotional void. However, no person can fulfill all of another's expectations.

Jacques Lacan was a French psychoanalyst and psychiatrist born on April 13, 1901, in Paris and who died on September 9, 1981, in the same city. He is considered one of the most influential and controversial figures in 20th-century psychoanalysis, especially for his reinterpretation of Sigmund Freud's ideas.

Lacan studied medicine and specialized in psychiatry before devoting himself prominently to psychoanalysis. Throughout his career, he developed a theoretical proposal that sought to recover certain Freudian concepts by means of tools drawn from linguistics, philosophy, and other disciplines within the human sciences.

One of his central ideas was that the unconscious is structured like a language. With this formulation, Lacan argued that unconscious desires, conflicts, and experiences could be understood through words, symbols, and the ways in which people construct meaning.

articles.title: Maya Angelou, American memoirist and essayist: "You may encounter many defeats but you must not be defeated meaning"
articles.standfirst: Angelou fought back from early childhood trauma to become one of the most celebrated writers in the USA
articles.summary: Angelou fought back from early childhood trauma to become one of the most celebrated writers in the USA
articles.body:
Maya Angelou 's writing explored the relationship between hardship, self-worth and the determination to keep moving forward. As an American memoirist, poet and civil rights activist, she drew on difficult personal experiences to examine how people can endure adversity without allowing it to define their lives.

Born Marguerite Annie Johnson in St. Louis, Missouri , on April 4, 1928, Angelou became one of the most influential literary figures of the 20th century. Her work addressed racism, trauma, identity and resilience, themes that continue to shape how readers understand her message about overcoming life's challenges.

“You will face many defeats in life, but never let yourself be defeated,” Angelou once wrote, a quote that captures the distinction between experiencing failure and allowing it to determine your future.

Its message is that setbacks are an unavoidable part of life, but they do not have to destroy a person's confidence, ambitions or belief in what remains possible and the central idea is that a disappointing outcome does not have to become a permanent verdict on someone's potential.

Losing an opportunity, struggling to achieve a goal or experiencing a painful personal setback can be difficult, but none of these experiences automatically determines what happens next and Angelou 's own life provides important context for understanding why resilience became such a prominent theme in her writing.

What does Angelou's quote about defeat mean?

During her childhood, Angelou experienced family separation, racism and sexual abuse. Following a traumatic experience, she stopped speaking for several years and developed a deep appreciation for books and language.

She eventually transformed her experiences into literature that reached readers around the world after her memoir, I Know Why the Caged Bird Sings , recounted her early life and explored the challenges of developing an identity amid discrimination and personal suffering.

The book established her as a major literary voice willing to confront painful subjects directly and the quote encourages people to approach failure as an experience rather than an identity. Someone who fails an examination, for instance, can examine what went wrong and prepare differently.

A job rejection might prompt a person to develop new skills or consider another opportunity. In both cases, the setback remains real, but it does not have to dictate the individual's next decision. Resilience, however, does not mean ignoring disappointment or pretending that every struggle will produce an immediate success.

Recovery can take time, and some circumstances are beyond an individual's control. The message is instead about preserving the possibility of moving forward, even when the path becomes more difficult than expected and Angelou' s wider body of work captured the theme as she explored dignity, freedom and the capacity to endure adversity.

Her experiences informed a perspective that recognized suffering without treating it as the final word on a person's life. Ultimately, the quote offers encouragement rather than a guarantee of victory.

articles.title: Sydney Sweeney stirs controversy again with her new Novig video
articles.standfirst: The actress is back at the center of the conversation.
articles.summary: The actress is back at the center of the conversation.
articles.body:
When Sydney Sweeney unveiled her campaign for Novig on September 9, criticism quickly followed. Under the slogan “Novig is Just Sports,” the actress posed nude, using various sports equipment to cover her body. The campaign reignited the debate over the sexualization of women in sports and the challenges they face in earning the recognition their talent deserves.

Sydney Sweeney shares another video for Novig

Despite the backlash sparked by the first installment, Sweeney is continuing the collaboration. In her latest post, the actress addresses men who create spreadsheets to bet on the color of her underwear. “There are grown men making spreadsheets to bet on what colour underwear I'm wearing. I mean, I'm flattered,” she says, before mentioning other markets involving the deaths of dictators, potential insider trading and people wagering their life savings on a war.

The message ends by drawing a distinction between those types of bets and sports trading, which the platform presents as its main focus: “And then, there are people who just trade on sports. Novig is just sports.”

However, the message isn't the only thing drawing attention to the ad. In the footage, Sweeney appears in white underwear with no top, her chest strategically covered by her hair and the camera angles . At the end, she holds two footballs in front of her body, keeping sensuality at the center of the campaign.

articles.title: Cardi B celebrates her birthday, and her sexiest looks continue to turn heads
articles.standfirst: The rapper turns 34, and we revisit four photos in which red, black, pink, and urban-inspired fashion reveal different sides of her style.
articles.summary: The rapper turns 34, and we revisit four photos in which red, black, pink, and urban-inspired fashion reveal different sides of her style.
articles.body:
C ardi B turns 34 on October 11, making it the perfect opportunity to revisit some of her most eye-catching looks . The American rapper has made fashion a recognizable part of her public image, with outfits that blend sensuality, luxury, and an attitude that never goes unnoticed. From form-fitting dresses and plunging necklines to statement accessories, these four photos show why her fashion choices continue to spark conversation.

Cardi B and the power of a red dress

One of her most striking looks came on June 19, 2026, when Cardi B shared an outfit centered around a shimmering red dress with a figure-hugging silhouette . The plunging neckline and leather-effect finish make the piece the focal point of the look, while its fitted cut accentuates her figure without the need for too many additional elements.

The sparkling necklace draped across her neckline adds a touch of classic glamour, contrasting with her pointed black nails and dark handbag. Her voluminous black waves and bold eye makeup complete the look, creating a Hollywood diva aesthetic with a daring twist.

Cardi B's urban and futuristic side

In another photo, published on December 6, 2025, the rapper embraces a completely different style. Her long, dark gray dress, featuring lighter details and a distressed finish, moves away from the shine of red in favor of an urban, experimental aesthetic .

The plunging neckline and exposed shoulders contrast with the long sleeves and body-hugging silhouette that extends to her ankles. Her ash-blonde hair, with silver undertones and dark roots, reinforces the futuristic feel of the outfit. Here, the impact comes not from accessories but from the mix of textures, the dress's cut, and the contrast between the garment and her hairstyle.

Pink, gold, and a maximalist statement

On September 4, Cardi B shared a pink ensemble featuring a draped crop top and a voluminous floor-length skirt . Both pieces share the same shade, but the gold accessories completely transform the energy of the outfit.

A belt made of large metallic rings stands out at the waist, paired with chunky bracelets that reinforce the look's maximalist appeal. The result blends Greek-inspired elements with a luxurious aesthetic and a much brighter color palette than the dresses featured in her other looks.

The black dress that embraces drama

The fourth look, published on June 30, 2026, brings black back into the spotlight with an outfit that combines lace, sheer details, and a mermaid-style skirt . The upper section, featuring a sweetheart neckline and corset-style structure, defines her figure, while feather embellishments along the bottom add volume and movement.

Cardi B keeps her accessories understated, allowing the dress to command all the attention. Her sleek, straight black hair, sparkling earrings, and warm-toned makeup complete a look that channels red-carpet glamour with a boudoir-inspired twist.

articles.title: Jack Welch, American business executive: "Face reality as it is, not as it was or as you wish it to be"
articles.standfirst: Welch was the chairman and CEO of General Electric from 1981-2001
articles.summary: Welch was the chairman and CEO of General Electric from 1981-2001
articles.body:
J ack Welch transformed General Electric into one of the world's most valuable corporations during his two decades as chief executive as his leadership emphasized accountability, aggressive restructuring and financial performance – and his philosophical approach was grounded in pragmatism. Born in Peabody , Massachusetts on November 19, 1935, Welch was the only child of Grace Andrews and railroad conductor John Francis Sr. , and he attended Salem High School before studying chemical engineering at the University of Massachusetts Amherst .

Graduating in 1957, Welch continued his education at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign , earning a master's degree and a doctorate in chemical engineering in 1960 and later that year, he joined GE as a junior engineer in Massachusetts . Beginning a career that would eventually place him among the country's most prominent corporate leaders, Welch adopted a fearless approach that allowed him to tackle problems as they presented. “Face reality as it is, not as it was or as you wish it to be,” Welch once said, expressing a management philosophy built around confronting difficult decisions rather than avoiding them.

How Welch reshaped General Electric

Welch became GE 's chairman and CEO in 1981, introducing a demanding strategy that required businesses to hold first- or second-place positions in their markets. Divisions that failed to meet the standard faced restructuring, sale or closure, while management layers were reduced. His policies brought substantial workforce reductions, earning him the nickname Neutron Jack. He also rewarded high-performing managers through bonuses and stock options, while promoting competition and accountability. Supporters praised his drive for efficiency, but critics questioned the human cost of his methods as during his tenure, GE expanded beyond its traditional industrial operations. The 1986 acquisition of RCA brought NBC into the company's portfolio, while GE Capital grew into a major financial services business. By 2000, annual revenue had climbed to almost $130 billion. He also introduced Six Sigma quality controls in 1995, seeking to reduce errors and improve business processes. His results earned widespread recognition, including Fortune magazine naming him its Manager of the Century in 1999, cementing his reputation as a defining executive of his era. Welch retired in 2001, leaving GE with an enormous market valuation, securing a huge retirement package estimated at approximately $420 million, one of the largest compensation arrangements of its time. After leaving GE , he advised businesses, spoke publicly about management and co-authored Winning with his third wife, Suzy . Welch died from kidney failure in New York City in March 2020, aged 84.

articles.title: Jim Ryun, Olympic athlete: "Motivation is what gets you started. Habit is what keeps you going"
articles.standfirst: Ryun also found a career in politics, working alongside President George W. Bush
articles.summary: Ryun also found a career in politics, working alongside President George W. Bush
articles.body:
J im Ryun , the American middle-distance runner and former congressman, built his reputation through record-breaking speed, but also strict discipline and a strong sense of determination. Born in Wichita, Kansas , on April 29, 1947, Ryun emerged as a running prodigy from a young age and in 1964, he became the first high school athlete to run a mile in under four minutes, launching a career that would make him a standout in track and field.

Ryun kept improving, running a mile in 3:55.3 in 1965 and setting world records in the half-mile and mile in 1966. The following year, he set the 1500-meter world record at 3:33.1, a mark that remained unbeaten for seven years. But it wasn’t just his talent alone as Ryun 's words, “Motivation is what gets you started. Habit is what keeps you going,” reflect the persistence behind his successes that later brought major honors. Ryun won the 1966 Sports Illustrated Sportsman of the Year award and the James E. Sullivan Award as America’s top amateur athlete, and also claimed NCAA indoor mile titles in 1967 , 1968 and 1969 . Ryun competed at three Olympic Games , starting in Tokyo in 1964 at just 17, and his defining result came in Mexico City in 1968, where he won silver in the 1500 meters behind Kenya ’s Kip Keino , despite running faster than he had expected the winning time to be. At altitude in Mexico City , Keino set a relentless pace before Ryun moved from eighth to second over the final two laps as he finished in 3:37.8, but Keino ’s Olympic-record 3:34.91 secured gold in one of the Games ’ memorable distance races. Ryun ’s final Olympics came in Munich in 1972 ended after he fell during his 1500-meter qualifying heat following a collision. Though officials acknowledged a foul had occurred, his appeal for reinstatement was rejected, keeping him out of the final.

From Olympic glory to public office: Ryun’s switch to politics

After leaving athletics, Ryun opted to enter politics and swiftly found success as he won election to the U.S. House of Representatives in 1996 as a Republican for Kansas ’s second district, beginning a decade in Washington. ​ In Congress , Ryun served on the Armed Services, Budget and Financial Services committees and showed belief in his principles as he broke with President George W. Bush on education and Medicare legislation, citing concerns about federal control and future costs under the Republican government. Ryun later lost his seat to the Democrats' Nancy Boyda in 2006 and failed to win the Republican nomination to reclaim it. In his later life, he has co-authored books with his sons, keeping a connection to his sport and his family. The quote about motivation and habit expresses a lasting lesson: ambition may start a pursuit, but consistent effort helps talent grow, and results endure and is particularly powerful from a man who transitioned from elite athletic success to elected office.

articles.title: Virginia Fonseca gets back with her ex, singer Zé Felipe, after breaking up with Vinicius
articles.standfirst: Less than 24 hours after her definitive breakup with the Real Madrid striker became public, the content creator was photographed on the beaches of Miami alongside the father of her three children.
articles.summary: Less than 24 hours after her definitive breakup with the Real Madrid striker became public, the content creator was photographed on the beaches of Miami alongside the father of her three children.
articles.body:
The world of romance and sports has been shaken after the end of the relationship between footballer Vinícius Júnior and Brazilian businesswoman Virginia Fonseca was confirmed. Just four months after giving their relationship a second chance this summer and only four weeks after exchanging engagement rings, the couple has decided to put an end to their story .

The news of the end of the romance reached the media through people closest to the content creator, as reported by outlets such as Libertad Digital, El Imparcial, or Estadio Deportivo. Through official spokespersons, Virginia's inner circle insisted that the decision was made by mutual agreement and in a peaceful manner , stating categorically that "there was no fight or conflict" between the two parties .

However, despite this official message of harmony, speculation was quick to arise due to the posts published by the businesswoman herself on her official profiles. Before the breakup was confirmed, Virginia shared a motivational reflection in which she spoke openly about "walking away from what hurts" , as well as avoiding "negative energies" and the "lack of reciprocity," enigmatic texts that her followers immediately interpreted as hints aimed at the Real Madrid player .

The reunion on the beaches of Miami

Just one day after the bombshell broke, the story took an even more striking turn when Virginia was seen on U.S. soil alongside her ex-husband , the popular singer Zé Felipe . The scene was captured in a video shared by a close friend and picked up by outlets such as Goal.com, where the former couple can be seen strolling casually along a beach in the city of Miami .

articles.title: Morgan Freeman, Hollywood star: “By age 40, you should be smart enough to realize this”
articles.standfirst: The Oscar winner has no plans to retire and explained the philosophy he shares with Clint Eastwood for facing the passing of the years and staying active as he approaches 90. “Keep moving, that’s the secret to everything”
articles.summary: The Oscar winner has no plans to retire and explained the philosophy he shares with Clint Eastwood for facing the passing of the years and staying active as he approaches 90. “Keep moving, that’s the secret to everything”
articles.body:
Morgan Freeman has spent more than six decades in front of the cameras, has appeared in more than 100 films, and won an Oscar. At 89, retirement is not among his plans either. The actor has a simple explanation for continuing to work: staying active.

In an interview with AARP published in November 2025, Freeman spoke about his career, the passing of the years, and the reason he continues to accept new projects. When he was asked directly whether he planned to retire, he was blunt: “No, no.” He then explained why he keeps working.

'"There is a saying about old age: ‘Keep moving’ , and what Clint Eastwood says: ‘Don’t let the old man in’. The way to do that is to keep getting up in the morning, keep working out at the gym, keep taking your vitamins, keep taking the medications you’ve been prescribed, and keep moving. Keep moving. That’s the secret to everything ,” he stated.'

The Clint Eastwood phrase that Morgan Freeman made his own

Freeman took as a reference one of Clint Eastwood's best-known phrases : “Don’t let the old man in” , which can be translated as “No dejes entrar al viejo”.

'“ Most days, when it’s sunny, that’s what I think: Are we going to be able to play golf today? ,” he said. Freeman lives next to a golf course and plays whenever he can.'

The years, of course, have forced the actor to make some adjustments. Freeman explained that he has problems with his right foot and that walking too much can be difficult for him, so he uses a cart during part of his rounds. Even so, golf remains one of his priorities.

And he still allowed himself a little joke about his level: “I'm pretty good. For an amateur, I'm pretty good.”

The Oscar did not change the way he looked

Freeman also recalled the Oscar he won in 2005 for Best Supporting Actor for Million Dollar Baby. The recognition, he explained, did not change who he was.

“It didn’t change me one bit”, he said. According to Freeman, winning the Oscar could translate into better professional opportunities and perhaps an increase in his fees, but nothing more.

“The only thing you can expect after winning an Oscar is that maybe your price will go up a little and your job opportunities will increase a little” , he explained. And he left a warning: “Don’t let your ego take over.”

The best advice he ever received in his life

During an interview, Freeman also revealed what he considers the best advice he has ever been given. It was not a phrase from another actor or from one of his great Hollywood colleagues. "Never look for trouble"

"Who told him?" The answer was even more curious: "A train driver".

Freeman also spoke about the people who shaped his career. He mentioned Sidney Poitier as one of his great mentors and chose Meryl Streep when he was asked which actress he would still like to work with.

“Absolutely. She’s at the very top of my list. She’s the best,” he said about Streep.

Morgan Freeman doesn't have a bucket list

At 89, Freeman also doesn't seem worried about completing a bucket list before turning 90. He then defined himself in a very simple way: “I’m just a traveling actor”.

Meanwhile, his career continues. In Now You See Me: Now You Don’t he reprised his role as Thaddeus Bradley, the character he had already played in the previous installments of the saga.

The film arrived in theaters in November 2025, but for Freeman the project seems to fit into a philosophy that goes far beyond one specific movie. At 89, his answer on how to face the passage of time remains the same: r ise, work, and keep moving.

articles.standfirst: The Czech reporter from FK Viagem Ústí nad Labem caught the attention of all the fans
articles.summary: The Czech reporter from FK Viagem Ústí nad Labem caught the attention of all the fans
articles.body:
Sabina Jaksova, a Czech television journalist, has gone viral in recent days for her pitch-side interview with David Olehla, coach of FK Viagem Ústí nad Labem, from the Second Division of the Czech Republic.

Fans joked about the awkward situation the coach went through during the conversation as he tried not to look at the beautiful reporter, who was wearing a low-cut top covered by an elegant white jacket. Sabina has only recently started interviewing the Czech team's key figures, after being hired last summer, according to the Daily Star.

'"The club's management contacted me directly to make me the offer. I admit that I felt pleased and surprised at the same time. I thought about it for a while, but in the end I said: why not?, I'll give it a try. But I had no experience, so I learned everything on the fly," she said.

"The truth is that I like learning new things and having new experiences, continuing to develop. At the same time, everything is very authentic. I'm discovering how the club works as I go along," she said.

"Of course I have my limits. Above all, I want to feel natural and comfortable. I try to put both the issue of clothing and the matters we discuss into perspective, but if something were to cross the line, I would say so," she stated.

articles.title: Metallica’s James Hetfield blasts celebrity agendas during the band’s Sphere concert in Las Vegas
articles.standfirst: The Metallica frontman delivered a powerful message during the band’s Sphere residency, making it clear what the group stands for.
articles.summary: The Metallica frontman delivered a powerful message during the band’s Sphere residency, making it clear what the group stands for.
articles.body:
Last October 10, 2026, in the very heart of Las Vegas, James Hetfield once again made it clear why Metallica is not only one of the most important bands in the history of rock, but also a group that firmly upholds its principles about what its music represents.

In front of thousands of fans gathered at The Sphere , the impressive immersive-technology venue that has turned every one of the band’s performances into a unique audiovisual experience, the Metallica frontman delivered a message that quickly began circulating among heavy metal fans.

Before starting one of the concerts of their Las Vegas residency, Hetfield thanked the fans who had traveled to join the band.

“Unless you live in Vegas, you’ve come a long way to spend some time with Metallica.”

Hetfield continued, “We’re grateful for that. Your travels, the money you spend, the time it took, thanks for coming to celebrate with us.”

However, the message gained force when he spoke about the band’s stance on topics outside of the music.

“We are here, no bullshit – we’re here to forget about all the outside shit, OK? Metallica’s agenda is love, energy and heavy music, baby.”

The vocalist’s words were recorded by several attendees and shared on social media. Although he did not mention any specific names, the message was interpreted as a criticism of artists who use their concerts as a platform to express political or ideological positions.

A philosophy Metallica has maintained for decades

This is not the first time Hetfield has spoken about Metallica’s decision to stay away from political or religious messages at their concerts.

In 2016 , during the promotion of the album Hardwired… to Self-Destruct, the musician explained that the band avoided those topics because they could create divisions among their fans. For Hetfield, music has the power to unite people with different ideas, cultures, and beliefs through a shared passion.

That philosophy was once again present during their performance at The Sphere.

Metallica’s residency at The Sphere

The statements were made during Metallica’s residency at The Sphere , one of the most innovative venues in the entertainment world thanks to its enormous screens and immersive technology.

The band began this series of concerts in October and has shows scheduled through March 2027 , taking advantage of the venue’s visual capabilities to create a different experience every night.

articles.title: Nero, emperor of Rome: “A man's acts can be cruel, without the man himself being cruel”
articles.standfirst: On an October 13 like today, he was proclaimed emperor in Rome
articles.summary: On an October 13 like today, he was proclaimed emperor in Rome
articles.body:
Throughout the history of Spain there have been figures who have changed the destiny of a nation or the history of a city. Such is the case of Nero. Historically, his reign has endured for its tyranny. This Roman emperor even went so far as to execute his mother and his stepbrother, which led him to be very popular among the people.

It should be borne in mind that in his early years in power, Nero made use of the help of figures such as Seneca and Burrus , which improved governance. Measures were also carried out to control certain tax abuses and limit some unfair practices by tax collectors.

On the other hand, Nero promoted music, theater, and other artistic expressions, as well as organizing games and public celebrations. But if he has gone down in history for anything, it is also for the endless quotes he left behind, which have been passed down from generation to generation until reaching our times.

Nero, emperor of Rome, separates obligation and intention: terrible deeds are not done for pleasure, but out of duty

In fact, in this article we focus on one of them. “A man's acts can be cruel, without the man being cruel” , Nero declared. What he meant is that anyone can commit terrible, destructive, or painful actions. And they do not do so for pleasure, but because circumstances may force them to.

Now, if this phrase comes from a ruler of Nero's stature, many historians have also identified it as a way of exonerating himself from acts that, in the eyes of the rest of society, could be atrocious. What the Roman emperor does with this reflection is separate intention and obligation, two very different concepts when you are the one making the decisions.

His commitment to shaping future generations in science and engineering reflects a critical response to the overwhelming stimuli of contemporary society. By championing education, he offers a pathway for individuals to find meaning and resilience amidst the chaos of today’s fast-paced world .

His experiences with NASA and contributions to the Apollo Program demonstrated the critical role of collaboration in overcoming challenges and pushing the boundaries of human potential.

It serves as a reminder that significant achievements are rarely the result of individual efforts alone but are instead a product of shared dedication and camaraderie. This narrative of teamwork threads through his legacy, reinforcing the idea that collective success is essential to overcoming the obstacles we face.

In our everyday lives in the 21st century, Armstrong's message about teamwork can be applied across various contexts—from workplaces to community initiatives. Modern challenges often require collaborative solutions, and understanding the power of working together can help individuals navigate complexities in both personal and professional arenas. In an age marked by rapid change and uncertainty, deriving inspiration from Armstrong’s commitment to teamwork can guide people to foster connections, share knowledge, and work collectively towards shared goals, ultimately leading to greater achievements and fulfillment.

articles.title: Dalai Lama XIV, spiritual leader: "Happiness is not something ready made. It comes from your own actions"
articles.standfirst: The Dalai Lama is the leader of Tibetan Buddhism and is considered very wise
articles.summary: The Dalai Lama is the leader of Tibetan Buddhism and is considered very wise
articles.body:
Happiness is often treated as something waiting at the end of a long journey, dependent on career success, financial security or finding the right relationship, but the Dalai Lama offers a different perspective, emphasizing how everyday choices can shape our sense of fulfillment. The 14th Dalai Lama , Tenzin Gyatso , holds a distinctive position in Tibetan Buddhism , where he is regarded as an incarnation of Avalokiteshvara , the bodhisattva associated with compassion – giving him immense wisdom and insight into the human soul.

After leaving Tibet in 1959, he established himself in India , supporting efforts to preserve Tibetan religious institutions, education and cultural traditions and his teachings have reached audiences well beyond Buddhism , emphasizing kindness, forgiveness, patience and concern for the suffering of others. “Happiness is not something ready-made. It comes from your own actions,” the Dalai Lama said in The Art of Happiness , which he co-authored with a psychiatrist named Howard C. Cutler in 1998. The Dalai Lama ’s international influence also stems from his advocacy for peaceful solutions, compassion and dialogue across religious and cultural boundaries as he makes sure he attempts to live by his words, and in 1989, he received the Nobel Peace Prize for his commitment to nonviolence.

What does the Dalai Lama's quote mean?

The Dalai Lama ’s message challenges the idea that contentment must wait until life becomes perfect, stressing it is easy to connect happiness to future milestones such as passing an exam, landing a new job or finding someone who returns our affection can bring genuine joy. But relying entirely on these outcomes leaves our well-being dependent on circumstances we cannot always control as the Dalai Lama 's perspective instead encourages people to recognize the influence of their attitudes, responses and everyday behavior. Repeated actions gradually become habits, shaping how we approach challenges and interact with others. Choosing patience over anger or understanding over resentment cannot eliminate every difficulty, but such responses can influence our experience of life. The message is not that happiness can be switched on at will. It is that personal choices can contribute to a more meaningful life, even when circumstances remain imperfect. The Dalai Lama 's message encourages people to look beyond external achievements when considering what makes life satisfying. Material security and supportive relationships matter, but the way people treat themselves and others can also influence their well-being. Small decisions can have lasting consequences. Practicing gratitude, responding calmly to frustration, offering help and making time for meaningful relationships can encourage habits that support a more compassionate outlook.

articles.title: Herman Melville, American writer: "It is better to fail in originality than to succeed in imitation"
articles.standfirst: Melville is best known for creating the classic, Moby Dick
articles.summary: Melville is best known for creating the classic, Moby Dick
articles.body:
H erman Melville , the novelist whose Moby-Dick became one of the most celebrated works in American literature, explored the value of independent thought and creative ambition throughout his career. Born in New York City on August 1, 1819, Melville experienced financial hardship after his father's death in 1832. He went to sea in 1839, later joining the whaling ship Acushnet before leaving it in the Marquesas Islands, experiences that would influence his early fiction.

His first novel, Typee , published in 1846, drew on his Pacific adventures and achieved considerable success. Its sequel, Omoo , followed in 1847, helping establish his reputation as a writer of maritime adventure. However, Melville gradually pursued more ambitious literary and philosophical questions and created Moby-Dick , which tells the story of sailor Ishmael and Captain Ahab 's obsessive pursuit of the white whale that took the captain's leg. "It is better to fail in originality than to succeed in imitation," is perfectly captured in Moby Dick , which offers reflections on morality, fate, social divisions and humanity's struggle to understand existence and shows Melville 's willingness to experiment with narrative style distinguished the book from conventional adventure fiction. Its message nevertheless resonates with the challenges he faced while developing a literary style that departed from popular expectations.

How Moby Dick proves Melville’s philosophy

When Moby-Dick appeared, it received mixed reviews and failed commercially whilst Melville 's subsequent novel, Pierre : or, The Ambiguities , also struggled to find an audience, leaving him unable to sustain his growing family through literary earnings alone. As public interest in his fiction declined, Melville moved to New York City in 1863 and eventually worked as a customs inspector as he increasingly concentrated on poetry, publishing Battle-Pieces and Aspects of the War in 1866 and the ambitious Clarel in 1876. And his later years brought personal tragedies, including the deaths of his sons Malcolm in 1867 and Stanwix in 1886 as he retired from his customs position that year and continued writing poetry. Melville did not live to witness his transformation into a literary icon, but it did not deter his passion for the quill. He died as his reputation began recovering around the centenary of his birth in 1919, when readers reconsidered the depth, of his work. Today, Moby-Dick is widely regarded as one of the defining American novels and is admired for its exploration of obsession, human limitations and the search for meaning. Its recognition illustrates how original work can outlast the tastes and judgments of its own era.

articles.title: Joe Manganiello is convinced Tom Cruise sabotaged his audition for Reacher because of Sofia Vergara
articles.standfirst: Cruise dated Vergara in the mid-2000s
articles.summary: Cruise dated Vergara in the mid-2000s
articles.body:
Joe Manganiello believes Tom Cruise may have influenced the casting of Amazon ’s Reacher series, costing him the lead role because of his past relationship with Sofia Vergara the actor recounts how a promising audition allegedly ended with his team questioning whether the Mission: Impossible star had intervened. Manganiello writes that he met Don Granger , an executive at Skydance Media , in January 2020 to discuss the adaptation of Lee Child ’s novels as their conversation reportedly lasted 90 minutes, including a discussion of criticism surrounding Cruise ’s portrayal of Reacher in the 2012 and 2016 films.

The character is described in the books as a towering 6-foot-5 figure, considerably taller than Cruise , who is famously around 5-foot-7 and Manganiello claims Granger praised his resemblance to the literary character. “You are the closest thing to Jack Reacher that I’ve ever met in my entire life,” Manganiello says Granger told him, in his memoir Bloodline . “You look like Reacher is described in the books. You have his effortless intelligence.” According to the memoir, showrunner Nick Santora was sufficiently impressed that he began writing the rest of the season with Manganiello in mind and the actor also says Skydance owner David Ellison and Child were “thrilled” with his performance. He believed he was a strong contender for the role but the situation reportedly changed when Manganiello was presented to Amazon executive Jen Salke as he claims she was angry about being excluded from the casting process. Manganiello also believes a group of predominantly male producers was pushing her toward a decision without her involvement and he ultimately did not land the part, which went to Cruise as he and his team considered several possible explanations. The memoir says they speculated that Cruise , who had served as an executive producer on the show, might have intervened and vetoed the casting because of Vergara , who reportedly dated in 2005, years before she married Manganiello in November 2015. However, the alleged intervention remains speculation attributed to Manganiello ’s team, rather than an established fact.

Cruise’s Digger faces a costly box-office struggle

Cruise is facing a separate challenge with Digger , his latest film, which has struggled to draw audiences and has reportedly earned about $35 million worldwide, far below the sums needed to justify its cost. Estimates put Digger ’s production budget and marketing expenses at roughly $280 million, with the film projected to finish its theatrical run near $50 million and those figures point to a substantial shortfall. Variety has estimated that Digger would need about $350 million worldwide to break even, whilst a Warner Bros. spokesperson has put the threshold slightly lower at closer to $300 million. Either way, the film’s current haul leaves it far from the level required to recoup its spending as ticket sales fell by 60 percent during Digger ’s second weekend, compounding concerns about its commercial prospects. Cruise has said box-office figures are not what he thinks about while making a film but the movie’s performance has put its finances under pressure.

articles.title: Usher wants Chris Brown’s jersey and refuses to let fans have it during performance
articles.summary: Chris Brown appeared ready to give fans a special souvenir by tossing his jersey into the crowd during a performance with Usher.
articles.body:
Chris Brown appeared ready to give fans a special souvenir by tossing his jersey into the crowd during a performance with Usher.

But before Brown could send it flying, Usher stepped in and made it clear that he wanted the jersey for himself.

The crowd may have wanted it, but Usher was not willing to surrender this piece of tour history.

The playful interruption became another memorable moment from their joint R&B Tour, showing the friendship and chemistry between the two stars beyond their music.
